title: Tallowbridge 视网膜外展套件选择
domain: 办公室与行政支持主管
role: 办公室与行政支持主管
instruction:
您是 Sasha Vasquez，Tanneryside Clinic 的患者就诊主管，正在为 Aneta Ainsworth 和 Wintergate 委员会准备外展计划。我们有 2,380 糖尿病患者逾期未进行视网膜筛查，而 $11,500 外展预算将于 30 6 月到期。阿内塔需要对渠道和人员组合提出合理的建议，以便在资金消失之前预订最确认的放映预约，而不是制定一般的沟通计划。候选外展块、其成本、预期确认预订收益率、语言覆盖范围、预订员要求、小组覆盖范围和运营限制均在`retinal_outreach_rules.xlsx`中；使用该工作簿作为事实来源。选择应资助的外展块，并使用这些文件名在工作目录的顶层生成 `retinal_outreach_allocation.xlsx` 和 `retinal_outreach_brief.pdf`。电子表格应显示选定和未选定的区块、支出和确认预订的计算、源中确定的每个患者部分的覆盖范围、预订职员和每日容量检查、停电期以及与明显的全加班方法的比较。
PDF 应将相同的分析转化为 Aneta 可供批准的分配建议，包括所选目标、假设、总支出、预期确认预订、每次确认预订的成本、比较案例以及任何重大运营权衡。两个文件必须在每个共享图形上达成一致。不要提交完整的面板，除非选定的块实际上覆盖了它，不要仅仅因为两个块到达一个语言段而对它进行两次计数，并且不要发明源中不存在的转换率或患者组。使用提供的操作规则提出有限制的建议，并准备好两个文件以供 20 June 审核。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/retinal_outreach_rules.xlsx` — 候选者外展块的真实来源、患者细分覆盖矩阵、预算和预订规则、人员配置限制、限制日期以及所有加班时间比较定义。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `retinal_outreach_allocation.xlsx` — 可审核的外展分配工作簿，其中包含候选人库、选定的集合、公式或透明计算、覆盖范围检查、容量和停电检查、客观结果以及与所有加班情况的比较。 （使用完全相同的文件名保存在工作目录的顶层。；使用retinal_outreach_rules.xlsx中提供的代码、段名称和策略定义。；使选定与未选定的块以及所有共享总计易于识别。；计算必须是可检查的，并且不得依赖于不受支持的发明输入。）
- `retinal_outreach_brief.pdf` — 一份可供批准的简明建议，解释所选的外展组合、目标、预算使用、预期预订、效率、覆盖范围、运营可行性以及与全加班方法的比较。 （使用完全相同的文件名保存在工作目录的顶层。；使用与电子表格相同的选定块和图形。；说明对目标和材料假设的所选解释。；保持演示文稿适合 Aneta Ainsworth 和 Wintergate Board。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.text:
Retinal Outreach Allocation Recommendation
Tanneryside Clinic • For Aneta Ainsworth and the Wintergate Board

Decision requested. Approve the mixed-channel set below for Sasha Vasquez to place before the 30 June budget
expiry. Ready for review by 20 June 2026.

    Measure                           Recommended plan                               All-overtime alternative

    Selected blocks                   OT-06, VC-01, VC-03, VC-04, VC-05, SMS-01, SMS-02,
                                                                                     OT-01,
                                                                                         SMS-03,
                                                                                            OT-02,
                                                                                                 SMS-04
                                                                                                   OT-03, OT-04, OT-05, OT-06, OT-08

    Spend                             $11,400                                        $8,050

    Expected confirmed bookings       1146                                           605

    Cost per confirmed booking        $9.95                                          $13.31



Recommendation. Fund OT-06, VC-01, VC-03, VC-04, VC-05, SMS-01, SMS-02, SMS-03, SMS-04. The set
maximizes expected confirmed screening appointments (1146) while spending $11,400 of $11,500 ($100 remaining).
Cost per confirmed booking is $9.95. The all-overtime benchmark yields 605 bookings, so the recommendation adds
541 bookings (89.4%).

Operational feasibility. Every source segment is covered using explicit source flags; general-language blocks are
not credited for Spanish or Hmong. Spanish coverage comes from selected blocks marked Spanish-speaking, and
Hmong coverage from blocks marked Hmong-speaking, with language closing demand never exceeding the two
available clerks. Selected activity avoids the 23–25 June blackout and stays within each permitted date. Per-date
booking-clerk demand is at or below the two-clerk ceiling.

Assumptions and trade-off. Confirmed bookings are source-provided expected yields, not contacts or guaranteed
outcomes; binary segment coverage does not mean all 2,380 overdue patients will be reached or booked. The mixed
set requires coordination across vendor, SMS, mail, and overtime channels, but improves expected bookings before
funds expire.

Approval owner: Aneta Ainsworth • Prepared by: Sasha Vasquez, Patient Access Supervisor • Organization:
Tanneryside Clinic

criteria.description: 电子表格显示在顶层，具有所需的确切文件名，并作为有效的工作簿打开。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件路径和工作簿的可读性。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的基本名称、扩展名和成功的工作簿解析。

original.criterion: The spreadsheet is present at the top level with the exact required filename and opens as a valid workbook.
original.evidence: Submitted file path and workbook readability.
original.grader_hint: Check exact basename, extension, and successful workbook parsing.

criteria.description: PDF 显示在顶层，具有所需的确切文件名，并作为有效的 PDF 打开。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件路径和 PDF 可读性。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的基本名称、扩展名和成功的 PDF 解析。

original.criterion: The PDF is present at the top level with the exact required filename and opens as a valid PDF.
original.evidence: Submitted file path and PDF readability.
original.grader_hint: Check exact basename, extension, and successful PDF parsing.

criteria.description: 该电子表格从源中识别每个候选外展块，并记录每个候选外展块的选定或未选定状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 将源候选代码与提交的表格进行匹配；不要求缺失或额外的候选人。

original.criterion: The spreadsheet identifies every candidate outreach block from the source and records a selected or unselected status for each.
original.grader_hint: Match source candidate codes to the submitted table; require no missing or extra candidate.

criteria.description: 所选集仅包含所提供源中存在的候选代码。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源候选池验证选定的标识符。

original.criterion: The selected set contains only candidate codes present in the supplied source.
original.grader_hint: Validate selected identifiers against the source candidate pool.

criteria.description: 每个候选块最多被选择一次。
criteria.evidence: 选择标志或选择集列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所选候选标识符的唯一性。

original.criterion: Each candidate block is selected at most once.
original.grader_hint: Check uniqueness of selected candidate identifiers.

criteria.description: 所选区块的总成本不超过$11,500预算。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿支出计算和选定成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源值重新计算选定的成本并与 11500 进行比较。

original.criterion: The total cost of selected blocks does not exceed the $11,500 budget.
original.evidence: Workbook spend calculation and selected costs.
original.grader_hint: Recompute selected costs from source values and compare to 11500.

criteria.description: 报告的总支出等于所选块的源成本之和。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式或透明计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 从候选表中重新计算；不接受手动输入的不受支持的总计。

original.criterion: Reported total spend equals the sum of the source cost for selected blocks.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from the candidate table; do not accept a manually typed unsupported total.

criteria.description: 源中每个所需的患者片段都由至少一个选定的块覆盖。
criteria.grader_hint: 对于每个源段，评估所选候选者之间覆盖范围的 OR。

original.criterion: Every required patient segment in the source is covered by at least one selected block.
original.grader_hint: For each source segment, evaluate the OR of coverage among selected candidates.

criteria.description: 当所选块未在源矩阵中标记其覆盖范围时，不会将任何段视为已覆盖。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个声明的覆盖段与源覆盖单元格进行比较。

original.criterion: No segment is treated as covered when the selected blocks do not mark coverage for it in the source matrix.
original.grader_hint: Compare every claimed covered segment with the source coverage cells.

criteria.description: 西班牙语面板覆盖范围满足来源要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 将提供的西班牙语段要求应用于所选集。

original.criterion: Spanish-speaking panel coverage meets the source requirement.
original.grader_hint: Apply the supplied Spanish segment requirement to the selected set.

criteria.description: 苗语面板覆盖范围满足来源要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 将提供的苗族细分要求应用于所选集。

original.criterion: Hmong-speaking panel coverage meets the source requirement.
original.grader_hint: Apply the supplied Hmong segment requirement to the selected set.

criteria.description: 选定的集合并不声称通用语言外展涵盖特定语言部分，除非来源明确标记该覆盖范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 针对源标志审核特定于语言的声明。

original.criterion: The selected set does not claim that general-language outreach covers a language-specific segment unless the source explicitly marks that coverage.
original.grader_hint: Audit language-specific claims against source flags.

criteria.description: 对于需要特定语言结账支持的每个选定区块，都满足两名职员预订约束。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源人员配置要求和规定的两名职员可用性。

original.criterion: The two-clerk booking constraint is satisfied for every selected block requiring language-specific closing support.
original.grader_hint: Use the source staffing requirement and the stated two-clerk availability.

criteria.description: 没有选定的区块超过源每日或每班订票员的容量。
criteria.grader_hint: 按源时间单位聚合选定的需求并与其上限进行比较。

original.criterion: No selected block exceeds the source per-day or per-shift booking-clerk capacity.
original.grader_hint: Aggregate selected demand by the source time unit and compare with its ceiling.

criteria.description: 源中断窗口中未安排选定的活动。
criteria.grader_hint: 将选定的活动日期或班次与提供的停电间隔相交。

original.criterion: No selected activity is scheduled in the source blackout window.
original.grader_hint: Intersect selected activity dates or shifts with the supplied blackout interval.

criteria.description: 每个选定的块都适合其源可用日期。
criteria.evidence: 候选人时间和选定的时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据每个候选人允许的窗口验证所选日期。

original.criterion: Every selected block fits within its source availability dates.
original.grader_hint: Validate selected dates against each candidate's permitted window.

criteria.description: 所选集尊重所有源硬约束，包括预算、覆盖范围、人员配置、容量、可用性和停电规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 对提交的选定集运行源约束检查器。

original.criterion: The selected set respects all source hard constraints, including budget, coverage, staffing, capacity, availability, and blackout rules.
original.grader_hint: Run the source constraint checker over the submitted selected set.

criteria.description: 报告的预期确认预订量等于选定区块的源预订收益率之和，没有重复计算重叠范围。
criteria.evidence: 产量计算和选定的候选记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源产量定义重新计算目标。

original.criterion: Reported expected confirmed bookings equal the sum of source booking yields for selected blocks, without double-counting overlapping reach.
original.evidence: Yield calculation and selected candidate records.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the objective according to the source yield definition.

criteria.description: 每次确认预订的报告成本等于总支出除以预期确认预订，±$0.01 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿和 PDF 效率数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用未四舍五入的基础总计重新计算比率。

original.criterion: Reported cost per confirmed booking equals total spend divided by expected confirmed bookings within ±$0.01.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the ratio using unrounded underlying totals.

criteria.description: 在所有硬约束内最大化预期确认预订的源目标下，所选择的可行集是最优的。
criteria.grader_hint: 枚举或求解有限二元选择模型并比较目标值。

original.criterion: The selected feasible set is optimal under the source objective of maximizing expected confirmed bookings within all hard constraints.
original.evidence: Selected set and source candidate pool.
original.grader_hint: Enumerate or solve the finite binary selection model and compare objective values.

criteria.description: 该建议将选定的集合标识为选定的客观解释，而不是呈现无法解释的组合。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿和 PDF 中的目标陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果计算一致支持的话，接受明确规定的预订最大化解释或经过深思熟虑的成本效率解释。

original.criterion: The recommendation identifies the selected set as the chosen objective interpretation rather than presenting an unexplained mix.
original.evidence: Objective statement in workbook and PDF.
original.grader_hint: Accept either a clearly stated booking-maximization interpretation or a deliberate cost-efficiency interpretation if calculations consistently support it.

criteria.description: 全加班比较完全使用了明显的全加班替代方案的源定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源规则重构基准；拒绝发明的基准假设。

original.criterion: The all-overtime comparison uses exactly the source definition of the obvious all-overtime alternative.
original.grader_hint: Reconstruct the benchmark from source rules; reject invented benchmark assumptions.

criteria.description: 比较报告在相同的支出、预期预订和每次预订成本的基础上报告所选计划和所有加班替代方案。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查两种情况下的通用单位、定义和源输入。

original.criterion: The comparison reports the selected plan and all-overtime alternative on the same basis for spend, expected bookings, and cost per booking.
original.grader_hint: Check common units, definitions, and source inputs across both cases.

criteria.description: 正如源模型所支持的那样，所选计划在所选目标或效率衡量标准上优于所有加班替代方案。
criteria.grader_hint: 从重新计算的基准值验证规定的方向。

original.criterion: The selected plan is shown to outperform the all-overtime alternative on the chosen objective or efficiency measure, as supported by the source model.
original.grader_hint: Verify the stated direction from recomputed benchmark values.

criteria.description: 当以百分比表示时，所选计划与比较案例之间报告的改进或差异在±0.1个百分点内是正确的。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算与未四舍五入的源对齐数字的百分比差异。

original.criterion: The improvement or difference reported between the selected plan and the comparison case is numerically correct within ±0.1 percentage points when expressed as a percentage.
original.grader_hint: Recompute percentage differences from unrounded source-aligned figures.

criteria.description: 工作簿中选定支出、预订和每次预订成本的总计与相应的 PDF 数字一致，美元值在 ±$0.01 范围内，计数在 ±0.1 范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取共享数据并在考虑显示舍入后进行比较。

original.criterion: Workbook totals for selected spend, bookings, and cost per booking agree with the corresponding PDF figures within ±$0.01 for dollar values and ±0.1 booking for counts.
original.grader_hint: Extract shared figures and compare after accounting for display rounding.

criteria.description: PDF 中选定的候选者列表与工作簿中选定的状态完全一致。
criteria.evidence: 两个文件中的选定阻止列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较标准化的候选代码，而不是视觉排序。

original.criterion: The selected candidate list in the PDF agrees exactly with the selected statuses in the workbook.
original.evidence: Selected block lists in both files.
original.grader_hint: Compare normalized candidate codes, not visual ordering.

criteria.description: PDF 在适当的批准背景下命名了 Sasha Vasquez、Aneta Ainsworth、Tanneryside Clinic 和 Wintergate Board。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取 PDF 文本并验证名称和组织背景。

original.criterion: The PDF names Sasha Vasquez, Aneta Ainsworth, Tanneryside Clinic, and the Wintergate Board in an appropriate approval context.
original.grader_hint: Extract PDF text and verify names and organizational context.

criteria.description: PDF 声明预算将于 6 月 30 到期，并给出 20 6 月审核截止日期或同等明确日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查提取文本中的日期。

original.criterion: The PDF states that the budget expires on 30 June and gives the 20 June review deadline or equivalent unambiguous dates.
original.grader_hint: Check dates in extracted text.

criteria.description: PDF 已准备好批准：它给出了明确的建议、决策理由、预期结果和实质性运营权衡，而无需读者重建模型。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断运营或财务审批者是否可以根据简报做出有限的决定。

original.criterion: The PDF is approval-ready: it gives a clear recommendation, decision rationale, expected outcome, and material operational trade-off without requiring the reader to reconstruct the model.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether an operations or finance approver could make a bounded decision from the brief.

criteria.description: 该建议将预期确认预订与联系、尝试或原始覆盖区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 两个可交付成果中的术语。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝将每次外展联系视为已确认预订的语言。

original.criterion: The recommendation distinguishes expected confirmed bookings from contacts, attempts, or raw reach.
original.grader_hint: Reject language that treats every outreach contact as a confirmed booking.

criteria.description: 该 PDF 解释了如何通过选定的组合和人员配置来保护讲西班牙语和苗语的患者。
criteria.evidence: 语言访问叙述和覆盖证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要基于来源的解释，而不仅仅是西班牙语和苗语。

original.criterion: The PDF explains how Spanish- and Hmong-speaking patients are protected by the selected mix and staffing arrangement.
original.grader_hint: Require a source-grounded explanation, not merely the words Spanish and Hmong.

criteria.description: 陈述了预期转化或预订数字的重大假设和限制，并未发明不受支持的事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用简洁的基于来源的警告；拒绝捏造的费率或患者类别。

original.criterion: Material assumptions and limitations of expected conversion or booking figures are stated without inventing unsupported facts.
original.grader_hint: Credit concise source-grounded caveats; reject fabricated rates or patient categories.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含可检查的候选人级别计算，而不仅仅是最终建议。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式、源链接字段或透明计算列。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式或可重现的计算逻辑。

original.criterion: The workbook contains an inspectable candidate-level calculation rather than only a final recommendation.
original.evidence: Workbook formulas, source-linked fields, or transparent calculation columns.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas or reproducible calculation logic.

criteria.description: 工作簿可以直观地识别选择后的预算剩余或预算利用率。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要与所选支出和源预算相关的派生值。

original.criterion: The workbook visibly identifies budget remaining or budget utilization after selection.
original.grader_hint: Require a derived value tied to selected spend and the source budget.

criteria.description: 该工作簿可以直观地识别容量和中断检查是否通过，并提供足够的详细信息来定位故障。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查整体状态和可操作的细节。

original.criterion: The workbook visibly identifies capacity and blackout checks as passed or failed, with enough detail to locate a failure.
original.grader_hint: Check both an overall status and actionable detail.

criteria.description: 呈现的工作簿没有剪切的标题、隐藏的必需列、不可读的错误值或阻止检查分配的溢出。
criteria.grader_hint: 在正常缩放下检查代表性渲染视图。

original.criterion: The rendered workbook has no clipped headers, hidden required columns, unreadable error values, or overflow that prevents reviewing the allocation.
original.grader_hint: Inspect representative rendered views at normal zoom.

criteria.description: 渲染的 PDF 没有剪切文本、空白页伪影、重叠元素或隐藏重要数据的表格溢出。
criteria.grader_hint: 目视或通过可靠的渲染元数据检查每个页面。

original.criterion: The rendered PDF has no clipped text, blank-page artifact, overlapping elements, or table overflow that hides material figures.
original.grader_hint: Inspect every page visually or through reliable rendering metadata.

criteria.description: 工作簿和 PDF 的组织方式使审阅者无需过多搜索即可找到建议、选定的块、可行性检查和比较。
criteria.evidence: 两者都提供了可交付成果。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估导航、标签和实际审查的可用性。

spec.professional_context: Enterprise outpatient access planning for a rural health cooperative, where a time-limited outreach budget must be converted into a documented, operationally feasible booking plan.
difficulty_sources: Selecting a feasible subset across budget, language coverage, staffing, timing, blackout, and capacity constraints
Comparing a mixed-channel optimum with the obvious all-overtime alternative
Maintaining figure and selected-code agreement across a spreadsheet and an approval PDF
Making a bounded objective interpretation explicit without inventing unsupported patient or conversion data

reference_file.purpose: Create one offline workbook containing the complete finite set-selection instance and all rules the solver needs. Include a candidate pool of approximately 18 to 24 outreach blocks spanning staff overtime calls, vendor calls, SMS blocks, and mailed letters. Each candidate should have a unique code, channel, permitted date or shift window, cost, expected confirmed-booking yield, required booking-clerk capacity, and binary coverage flags for approximately 8 to 10 patient segments, including Spanish-speaking and Hmong-speaking segments. Include a policy section defining the $11,500 budget, the two available language-capable closing clerks, the per-day or per-shift capacity ceilings, the blackout window within the horizon, the 30 June expiry, the 20 June review deadline, and the exact all-overtime comparison case.
required_vocabulary: Use the candidate codes, segment labels, and policy labels in the supplied workbook as the canonical vocabulary.
The solver must reproduce those codes and labels in the deliverables rather than inventing alternate identifiers.

instance_design.objective: Maximize total expected confirmed screening appointments subject to all hard constraints. A secondary cost-per-confirmed-booking view may be reported, but it must not replace the declared primary objective without an explicit deliberate interpretation.
instance_design.patient_panel: Represent the 2,380 overdue patients through source-defined segments and coverage criteria; coverage is a binary requirement over segments, not a claim that each patient is individually booked.
hard_constraints: Selected candidate cost sum is at most 11500.
Every source-defined patient segment is covered by at least one selected candidate.
Language-specific segments require candidates explicitly marked as reaching that language.
Selected candidates must fit their permitted date or shift windows.
No selected activity may occur during the blackout interval.
Aggregate booking-clerk demand must not exceed the source per-day or per-shift ceiling.
Language-specific closing demand must not exceed the two available closing clerks.
All selected candidate identifiers must be unique and drawn from the candidate pool.
instance_design.comparison_case: Define the obvious all-overtime alternative as selecting the overtime-call blocks to the maximum extent allowed by the source's budget, timing, capacity, and staffing rules, with no vendor, SMS, or mailed-letter blocks unless the source definition explicitly requires them. Store its spend, expected bookings, and efficiency using the same formulas as the recommended set.
contention: Make several high-yield blocks compete for the same scarce daily or shift capacity.
Make language-capable blocks compete for the two closing clerks.
Include an internal blackout that makes at least one otherwise attractive candidate unavailable or partially unusable.
Ensure the all-overtime alternative is feasible but materially inferior, while the optimal set combines channels.
Include near-miss candidates that are attractive on yield or price but fail one stated threshold, timing condition, language requirement, or capacity condition.
instance_design.tightness_target: Approximately 0.70 to 0.78: feasible choices should be meaningfully constrained, with several locally attractive combinations failing capacity, language staffing, blackout, or budget checks. A simple greedy sort by yield or cost must not reliably produce the optimum.
instance_design.solver_gold: Enumerate or solve the binary selection model offline, record at least one optimal feasible set, and emit a checker that accepts any set satisfying all hard constraints and attaining the optimum primary objective. The checker should recompute coverage, capacity, blackout, spend, and expected bookings from the source rather than depend on a fixed row order.
derived_relationships: Expected confirmed bookings are the sum of source yields for selected eligible blocks.
Cost per confirmed booking is total selected spend divided by expected confirmed bookings.
Segment coverage is the logical OR of selected candidate coverage flags, with no double-counting across overlapping candidates.
Benchmark improvement is calculated from source-aligned selected and all-overtime values.
Cross-deliverable checks compare normalized candidate codes and unrounded underlying totals where available.

quality_controls: Verify offline that at least one feasible selection exists and that the solver identifies the intended objective optimum.
Verify that every enforced rule appears in the request or the supplied workbook, never only in this plan.
Generate a reference solution workbook and PDF, recalculate all figures, and walk every rubric item against them.
Set reference_solution_passed_rubric to true only after checking both computational predicates and rendered usability.

original_instruction:
You are Sasha Vasquez, the patient access supervisor at Tanneryside Clinic, preparing an outreach plan for Aneta Ainsworth and the Wintergate Board. We have 2,380 diabetic patients overdue for retinal screening, and the $11,500 outreach budget expires on 30 June. Aneta needs a defensible recommendation for the channel-and-staffing mix that will book the most confirmed screening appointments before the money disappears, rather than a general communications plan. The candidate outreach blocks, their costs, expected confirmed-booking yields, language reach, booking-clerk requirements, panel coverage, and operating restrictions are in `retinal_outreach_rules.xlsx`; use that workbook as the source of truth. Select the outreach blocks that should be funded and produce `retinal_outreach_allocation.xlsx` and `retinal_outreach_brief.pdf` in the top level of the working directory, using exactly those filenames. The spreadsheet should show the selected and unselected blocks, calculations for spend and confirmed bookings, coverage of every patient segment identified in the source, the booking-clerk and daily-capacity checks, the blackout period, and a comparison with the obvious all-overtime approach. The PDF should turn the same analysis into an approval-ready allocation recommendation for Aneta, including the chosen objective, assumptions, total spend, expected confirmed bookings, cost per confirmed booking, the comparison case, and any material operational trade-off. The two files must agree on every shared figure. Do not commit the full panel unless the selected blocks actually cover it, do not count a language segment twice merely because two blocks reach it, and do not invent conversion rates or patient groups that are absent from the source. Make a bounded recommendation using the supplied operating rules and have both files ready for review by 20 June.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/retinal_outreach_rules.xlsx` — Source-of-truth candidate outreach blocks, patient-segment coverage matrix, budget and booking rules, staffing limits, blackout dates, and the all-overtime comparison definition.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `retinal_outreach_allocation.xlsx` — An auditable outreach allocation workbook containing the candidate pool, selected set, formulas or transparent calculations, coverage checks, capacity and blackout checks, objective results, and comparison with the all-overtime case. (Save at the top level of the working directory with exactly this filename.; Use the codes, segment names, and policy definitions supplied in retinal_outreach_rules.xlsx.; Make selected versus unselected blocks and all shared totals easy to identify.; Calculations must be inspectable and must not rely on unsupported invented inputs.)
- `retinal_outreach_brief.pdf` — A concise approval-ready recommendation explaining the selected outreach mix, objective, budget use, expected bookings, efficiency, coverage, operating feasibility, and comparison with the all-overtime approach. (Save at the top level of the working directory with exactly this filename.; Use the same selected blocks and figures as the spreadsheet.; State the chosen interpretation of the objective and material assumptions.; Keep the presentation suitable for Aneta Ainsworth and the Wintergate Board.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
